create_ParamGrid: create a ParamGrid with seed, env, and num_envs_per_worker parameter tuples for grid search
generate_params_ParamGrid: generate all parameter combinations from a ParamGrid using generate_params with randomize set to False
create_Experiment: create an Experiment with a name, APPO training command string, and a ParamGrid parameter generator
create_RunDescription: create a RunDescription named paper_doom_wall_time_v97_fs4 with a list of Experiment objects
run_experiment_cmd: run the APPO training command with doom_defend_the_center_flat_actions env and 100 million env steps
